## Other Resources

- [Yes, government cuts to fuel taxes really do lower your price at the pump](https://thehub.ca/2026/09/30/yes-the-government-cutting-fuel-taxes-really-does-lower-your-price-at-the-pump/) (Trevor Tombe, *The Hub*, September 30, 2026)

Trevor Tombe, one of the authors of our textbook, looks at recent federal and provincial fuel tax cuts and finds that pump prices fell by roughly the full amount of each cut. A good real-world application of tax incidence: who actually benefits when a tax is cut?
